notes.title: New Patch
notes.content:
[p]New Patch includes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed background render setting not working correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse clicks no longer works through UI[/p][/*][*][p]Now background resizes with the game window[/p][/*][*][p]Added more Chroma Key presets[/p][/*][/list][p]Also with that we have a Weekend Sale with -40%!  


You can always give us feedback in our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Virtual Keyboard Update!
notes.content:
[p]In this big update we focused on adding more usage of this Game/Tool, we added Virtual Keyboard support!
[/p][p]Now you don't need to have physical keyboard, you can use any virtual keyboard from your collection and write with it!
[/p][p]New Features and Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Virtual keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Support for mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Option to highlight pressed keys[/p][/*][*][p]There is now option to turn off/on camera renderer while game is not focused[/p][/*][*][p]New background color - Chroma key[/p][/*][*][p]Some keyboards rarities were changed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As this update is pretty hard to maintain and test, if you will have any issues, please leave the feedback in our Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link[/url][/p]

notes.title: We greatly reduced size of the game!
notes.content:
[p]In the newest update, we greatly reduced size of the game up to 5 times!

From 2.5Gb to only 500Mb!

Turns out, we had textures of keyboards in 4K resolution, but the difference weren't even noticable.

You can always give us feedback in our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: QoL and Fixes
notes.content:
[p]In this update we bring QoL features and fixes:[/p][list][*][p] Fixed issues with laptop keyboard making sound only in the right "ear"[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue of Envy Gradient keyboard having double clicks[/p][/*][*][p] Rare keyboards have less drop chance[/p][/*][*][p] Added settings for different screen mods and resolutions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are also working on overhauling rarities for keyboards, so there won't be issues like blue keyboard of model A being common, while green keyboard of model A being rare.[/p][p]
You can always give us feedback in our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: [p]In this update we improved some small issues and now the game would feel better:[/p][list][*][p]Added new icons to buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboards will drop with 100% instead of 13.789999999999f% chance each 30 minutes now[/p][/*][*][p]AFK Clicks are now added to statistics and total score[/p][/*][*][p]Added Discord button in the menu [/p][/*][/list][p] You can always leave your feedback on our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Major update is out - CRAFTING!
notes.content:
[p]In the newest update we added crafting and disassembling of keyboards.

You can craft new keyboards from 10 details any quality, that you can obtain by destroying old keyboards you don't want to keep with you.

We also greatly reduced chances of getting rare keyboards from time drops, and some keyboards can't even be dropped anymore, only crafted!

Update includes:[list]
[*][p] Crafting[/p]
[*][p] Disassembling[/p]
[*][p] Minor fixes and improvements[/p]
[/list]

You can always give us feedback in our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: New update is out!
notes.content:
[p]In this update we focused on better usability and feedback:
[/p][list][*][p]Now you can close menus on ESC[/p][/*][*][p]Added approximate timer for drops[/p][/*][*][p]Added notification mark if you got new keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes
[/p][/*][/list][p]We also reduced chances of getting more rare keyboards.
[/p][p]Remember that you can provide us feedback and ask question regardless of what current chances are in our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/qNGhyQ8VBJ"]link to Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Keyboard Simulator's Inventory is now open!
notes.content:
[p]Due to issues, inventory feature of our game was hidden, and you couldn't see it in Steam. But now it's all changed and it is open!

You can finally [b][i]trade[/i][/b] and just look at your beautiful keyboards!

Unfortunately, you can't display keyboards on your profile yet, as steam doesn't let us to.
Stay tuned and it's all can change too in the near future![/p]

notes.title: Keyboard Simulator is finally out on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]After so long time it is finally released, and because of that we made 40% OFF for 10 next days![/p][p]We will release more updates and skins in the near future and for now...


Thank all of you for your support, and have fun![/p]
